scope: Incoming cellular call UI and system power menu must be available during immersive focus; application protection resumes afterwards

reproduction.candidate17: Power menu fixed; unfocused top incoming-call banner remains covered because it does not cross screen centre
reproduction.final18: Trusted system interaction surfaces, including unfocused call banners, yield the cover; restrictions resume when closed

limitations: SystemUI notification panels and sufficiently large heads-up surfaces also yield protection; underlying restricted app may be visible or interactive until dismissal
Unfocused OEM banners smaller than 96dp or system windows without readable identity may still retain the cover
Xiaomi standalone call UI and other OEM ROMs not validated on physical devices
VoIP calls such as WeChat or QQ not tested; no blanket exemption for those apps
No actual power off/restart, full natural duration, or long lock-screen stability run this round
